name: moe_rebias_v1
hypothesis: Pre-scale BF16 storage passed all 5 shapes but inflated scale-buffer traffic and missed aggregate. Instead re-encode E4M3 scale exponent in the same 8 bits during prepare (source exponent e becomes e-1; source subnormals use sentinel 15), then use integer bit construction to recover exactly scale*2^119 as BF16 at runtime. This removes float conversion without increasing weight traffic.
